papers.title: Biocorrosion and In Vitro Biocompatibility of Additively Manufactured Ti-2Fe Alloy with Superior Mechanical Properties
papers.abstract: Additive manufacturing of biomedical titanium (Ti) alloys has attracted significant interest because of their potential use in patient-specific biomedical devices. Iron (Fe), an effective β-stabilizer, is capable of replacing toxic alloying elements, such as aluminum (Al) and vanadium (V), in biocompatible biomedical Ti-alloys. In this study, a Ti-2Fe alloy was produced using laser powder bed fusion (LPBF). The biocorrosion behavior and cytocompatibility of the synthesized material were systematically studied in conjunction with the mechanical properties. The Ti-2Fe alloy heat-treated at 800 °C for 30 min exhibited excellent mechanical properties (UTS ∼ 781 MPa, TEL ∼ 27.9%) together with high resistance to biocorrosion because of the formation of a stable passive film. Furthermore, because of the low release of Fe ions, cytocompatibility studies showed that the Ti-2Fe alloy had no adverse effects on the morphology or proliferation of MC3T3-E1 cells. As an alternative to the conventional Ti-6Al-4V alloy, the proposed Ti-2Fe alloy is a viable option for biomedical applications in orthopedics and dentistry.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是Ti-2Fe合金而非Ti-6Al-4V，与用户关注的L1方向完全不相关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper studies Ti-2Fe alloy, not Ti-6Al-4V, and focuses on biocorrosion and biocompatibility rather than mechanical/fatigue performance of Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发无毒合金元素替代Ti-6Al-4V中的Al和V。
summary_zh.method: 采用激光粉末床熔融制备Ti-2Fe合金并进行热处理。
summary_zh.result: Ti-2Fe合金具有良好力学性能、耐腐蚀性和细胞相容性。
summary_zh.validation: 力学测试、电化学腐蚀测试和体外细胞实验。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a biocompatible Ti alloy using non-toxic Fe as a β-stabilizer to replace hazardous Al and V.
summary_en.method: Ti-2Fe alloy was fabricated by laser powder bed fusion followed by heat treatment at 800°C for 30 min.
summary_en.result: The alloy exhibited high tensile strength (UTS 781 MPa) and elongation (27.9%) along with excellent corrosion resistance and cytocompatibility.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing, electrochemical biocorrosion tests, and in vitro MC3T3-E1 cell assays.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了通过机械融合分散纳米Y2O3增强激光粉末床熔融Ti-6Al-4V的力学性能，与方向L1直接相关。

summary_zh.motivation: 提高激光粉末床熔融Ti-6Al-4V的强度
summary_zh.method: 通过机械融合工艺分散纳米Y2O3颗粒
summary_zh.result: 获得高强度的氧化物弥散强化Ti-6Al-4V合金
summary_zh.validation: 力学性能测试验证强化效果

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the strength of Ti-6Al-4V produced by laser powder bed fusion through oxide dispersion.
summary_en.method: Nanoscale Y2O3 particles are dispersed in Ti-6Al-4V powder via mechanofusion, followed by LPBF processing.
summary_en.result: The oxide-strengthened Ti-6Al-4V exhibits significantly improved strength compared to the unreinforced alloy.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing, including tensile and hardness measurements, confirms the strengthening effect.
